name: IA-Framework
description: Reference Quality Gate. Evaluates new code only: 80% coverage, no new bugs or vulnerabilities, A ratings.

notes.where_it_lives: This file is the versioned definition. The live gate is configured in the SonarQube server (Quality Gates), by hand or through its API.
notes.why_80: 100% on new code turns mechanical changes (styling, defensive branches) into test-writing chores and pushes teams to disable the gate. 80% keeps new logic tested and leaves room for lines not worth a test.
